title.narrative: To contribute to the reduction of malaria mortality and morbidity in the general population for sustainable socio- economic development - Mauritania (01-Jul-2016-30-Jun-2019)

description.narrative: Mauritania, Malaria, National Executive Secretariat for the Fight Against AIDS of the Islamic Republic of Mauritania (SENLS Mauritania)This program has the following goals: To contribute to a reduction in mortality and general morbidity in the population to allow for sustainable socio-economic development. The objectives of this program are: To Improve program management and coordination capacities at all levels. To reduce malaria transmission to less than 1 case per 1,000 people in strata II and III. To stop transmission of malaria between indegenous populations in moughataa [departments of Mauritania] to sporadic transmission of stratum I
